landing.marketsTitle: Four asset classes. One trading account.
landing.marketsDesc: Forex, crypto, Indices, and metals — switch instruments without switching platforms.
landing.whyTitle: Built for traders who prefer signal over noise.
landing.whyDesc: Every part of the stack is designed to keep costs visible, execution steady, and risk under your control.
landing.reason1Body: See how pricing is structured before you size a position. No soft language around spreads.
landing.reason2Body: Routing is tuned for the moments depth thins — opens, overlaps, and news windows.
landing.reason3Body: Controls sit next to the order flow so exposure stays intentional, not accidental.
landing.conditionsTitle: Straight answers on pricing and access.
landing.platformTitle: One workspace at the desk and in your pocket.
landing.platformDesc: Charts, tickets, balances, and funding stay aligned — whether you are managing risk on a monitor or checking exposure on the move.
landing.platformPoint1: Same account and balance on web and Android
landing.platformPoint2: Live charts with order entry beside the chart
landing.platformPoint3: Deposits, withdrawals, and transfers from the client portal
landing.stepsTitle: Three steps from registration to live.
landing.step1Body: Create your profile and complete a short verification path.
landing.step2Body: Deposit with methods that match how you already move money.
landing.step3Body: Enter live markets from web or mobile with the same balance.

social.title: Social trading, built the Oceana way.
social.body: Connect with desks that publish clear track records — follow, allocate, or run a book without drowning in noise.
social.f1Body: Allocate to managed strategies with proportional fills and clear performance reporting.
social.f2Body: Follow desks you trust and mirror entries with risk limits that stay under your control.
social.f3Body: Structured ideas from the community — sized and filtered before they reach your ticket.
social.panelDesc: Follow strategies with risk that stays on your desk.
